children: Roivant announced that mosliciguat produced a 56.3% placebo-adjusted reduction in pulmonary vascular resistance in the Phase 2 PHocus study.
PHocus met primary endpoint: placebo-adjusted PVR reduction of -56.3% at Week 16 (p<0.0001), largest PVR fall reported in a randomized PH trial.
Secondary endpoints met: placebo-adjusted 6MWD +35.2m (p=0.0027) and NT-proBNP -53.2% (-357.7 pg/mL, p=0.0002) at Week 16.
Pre-specified exploratory Week 24 showed further gains: 6MWD +52.7m and NT-proBNP -75.9% (nominal p<0.0001 for both).
Mosliciguat was well tolerated with favorable safety; cough incidence lower vs placebo (12.1% vs 18.2%).
Phase 3 PHrontier study has been initiated with enrollment underway to evaluate mosliciguat in PH-ILD (~375 patients planned).

title: Roivant Announces Mosliciguat PHocus: 56.3% PVR Drop, 35.2m 6MWD Gain; Phase 3 Underway
